items.reason: Source 'All thy unnamable imminglings float beneath me here'; candidate prints 'inminglings', a misspelling of Melville's word (introduced in round 1 when 'inmixings' was restored; carried through the R2 accessibility edit). The R2 change itself ('gives it not again' -> 'does not give it again') is faithful. Fix: restore 'imminglings'.
items.new: "Oh, trebly hooped and welded hip of power! Oh, high aspiring, rainbowed jet! The one strives, the other jets, all in vain! In vain, oh whale, do you seek intercession with the all-quickening sun, that only calls forth life but does not give it again. Yet you, darker half, rock me with a prouder, if a darker faith. All your unnamable imminglings float beneath me here; I am buoyed by breaths of once living things, exhaled as air, but water now.
